title: Florence's Duomo Climb: ~$34. Xi'an's 1,370-Year-Old Pagoda: ~$11 | China Travel Expert
description:
Climbing the dome of Florence's Duomo costs about $34 (the Brunelleschi Pass, the only ticket that includes the climb). Climbing Xi'an's Giant Wild Goose Pagoda costs about $11 — the Da Ci'en Temple ticket plus the pagoda-climb add-on — roughly a third of the price.

The Giant Wild Goose Pagoda (Dayan Pagoda) was first built in the year 652, during the Tang dynasty, when Xi'an was the capital Chang'an. The monk and translator Xuanzang had it raised to hold the Buddhist sutras and images he carried back from India. It stands about 64 metres tall with seven storeys today — roughly 1,370 years of history you can still walk up.

Expert Tip: you need the Da Ci'en Temple ticket to reach the pagoda, then a separate add-on ticket to climb it — budget for both, and go early before the plaza fills.

西安大雁塔：公元652年由玄奘主持修建，用来存放他从印度带回的佛经；约64米、七层。爬大雁塔约11美元，爬佛罗伦萨大教堂圆顶约34美元——你会选哪一个？
